FAR_TRANS.CUSTOMER_INFORMATION.purpose: Stores historical snapshots of customer profile attributes including risk level and investment capacity over time.
FAR_TRANS.CUSTOMER_INFORMATION.grain: one row per customer per profile change date

FAR_TRANS.TRANSACTIONS.purpose: Stores all buy and sell transactions for financial assets executed by customers through various channels.

FAR_TRANS.CLOSE_PRICES.purpose: Stores the daily closing price for each financial asset identified by ISIN.
FAR_TRANS.CLOSE_PRICES.grain: one row per asset per day

FAR_TRANS.V_CUSTOMER_CURRENT.purpose: Stores the current state of customer profiles including risk level and investment capacity.

STG_POC.TRNSCTN.purpose: Stores all customer trading transactions including buys and sells of financial instruments.

FAR_TRANS.LIMIT_PRICES.purpose: Stores minimum and maximum price points for each asset over its trading history.

FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION.purpose: Stores comprehensive information about financial assets including identification, classification, and market details with temporal tracking.
FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION.grain: one row per asset (ISIN) per timestamp

STG_POC.ASST_INFO.purpose: Staging table containing raw asset information data before transformation into the production asset information table.
STG_POC.ASST_INFO.grain: one row per asset (ISIN) per timestamp

FAR_TRANS.V_ASSET_CURRENT.purpose: View providing the most recent or current state of asset information for active assets.
FAR_TRANS.V_ASSET_CURRENT.grain: one row per currently active asset (ISIN)

FAR_TRANS.MARKETS.purpose: Stores reference data for financial markets and exchanges where securities are traded.
